name: IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL
description: IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL stores information on payments. A payment is a single check or fund transfer transaction between first party payer and third party payee. A payment pays one or more documents payable, and there may be one or more payments in a payment instruction. Payments are built by grouping documents payable according to Oracle Payments' grouping rules. This table corresponds to the Payments tab of the Funds Disbursement Process Home.
